visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man's hand points toward a large promotional poster for 'WHILL Autonomous Service' located in a spacious airport terminal. The poster depicts a woman using a sleek black electric wheelchair. (2) Close-up shots of informational displays show detailed instructions on how to use the service and its destinations. (3) The man sits on the black cushioned seat of the wheelchair, which is equipped with a digital screen on the armrest and large, multi-directional front wheels. (4) POV shots show the man's hand selecting 'Traditional Chinese' and then 'ANA LOUNGE' on the touch interface. (5) The wheelchair begins moving autonomously through the bright terminal. The man, wearing a white shirt and a protective mask, records a selfie video while sitting, with luxury brand stores like Gucci visible in the background. (6) As the wheelchair approaches a person pushing a large luggage cart, it automatically slows down and maneuvers to the side to avoid them. (7) The man interacts with the screen to stop the trip and stands up. (8) The empty wheelchair displays a countdown on its screen and then autonomously navigates away, returning to its original station.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An adult male wearing a white button-down short-sleeved shirt and a white medical mask.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The interior of a modern airport terminal featuring polished light-gray tiled floors, vertical wooden slat walls, promotional banners, and high-end retail stores like Gucci and Bvlgari.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A lively male speaker begins with high arousal, introducing a service. Upbeat electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat starts simultaneously. (2) Digital 'blip' and 'click' SFX are layered over the speech as the user interacts with the UI. (3) A clear chime/bell sound triggers when the movement is activated. (4) As the wheelchair moves, the speaker continues a running commentary with a cheerful tone; background airport murmurs are faintly audible. (5) A sharp warning beep sound occurs when the wheelchair brakes for an obstacle, followed by an excited exclamation from the speaker. (6) More digital UI feedback sounds occur as the trip is finalized. (7) The video concludes with the BGM sustaining its energy alongside rhythmic beeping from the returning wheelchair.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Interaction Steps -> Live Experience -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase and review a new autonomous wheelchair service available for all passengers at an airport, highlighting its technological convenience and safety features.
